requirement.text: The THEMAS system shall permit a temperature deviation of up to 5 degrees Fahrenheit for any thermostat before reporting a deviation error.

classification.rationale: The requirement specifies temperature deviation thresholds and error reporting for thermostats in the THEMAS system. This is characteristic of an embedded, IoT, or backend control system, with no signals indicating a web, mobile, or AI-driven system.

rounds.text_checked: The THEMAS system shall permit a temperature deviation of up to 3 degrees Fahrenheit for any thermostat before reporting a deviation error.

test_strategy.rationale: The requirement defines a numeric threshold for temperature deviation ('up to 3 degrees Fahrenheit') before reporting a deviation error. Per the design strategy guidance, numeric ranges and thresholds map directly to equivalence partitioning (partitioning deviations into non-error values <= 3°F and error values > 3°F) and boundary value analysis (testing exact boundary limits such as 3.0°F, 3.1°F, -3.0°F, and -3.1°F).

test_cases.title: Boundary Value - Positive Deviation at Upper Limit (3.0°F)
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is powered on and actively monitoring a connected thermostat with target setpoint at 70.0°F.
steps: Simulate temperature sensor reading of 73.0°F (deviation of +3.0°F).
Observe system alerts and logs for 60 seconds.
test_cases.expected_result: The system permits the +3.0°F deviation and does not report a deviation error.

test_cases.title: Boundary Value - Positive Deviation Exceeding Upper Limit (3.1°F)
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is powered on and actively monitoring a connected thermostat with target setpoint at 70.0°F.
steps: Simulate temperature sensor reading of 73.1°F (deviation of +3.1°F).
test_cases.expected_result: The system detects that deviation exceeds 3 degrees Fahrenheit and reports a temperature deviation error.

test_cases.title: Boundary Value - Negative Deviation at Lower Limit (-3.0°F)
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is powered on and actively monitoring a connected thermostat with target setpoint at 70.0°F.
steps: Simulate temperature sensor reading of 67.0°F (deviation of -3.0°F).
Observe system alerts and logs for 60 seconds.
test_cases.expected_result: The system permits the -3.0°F deviation and does not report a deviation error.

test_cases.title: Boundary Value - Negative Deviation Exceeding Lower Limit (-3.1°F)
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is powered on and actively monitoring a connected thermostat with target setpoint at 70.0°F.
steps: Simulate temperature sensor reading of 66.9°F (deviation of -3.1°F).
test_cases.expected_result: The system detects that deviation exceeds 3 degrees Fahrenheit in the negative direction and reports a temperature deviation error.

test_cases.title: Equivalence Partitioning - Permitted Deviation Class (1.5°F)
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is active and monitoring thermostat with target setpoint at 72.0°F.
test_cases.expected_result: No deviation error is reported because 1.5°F is within the permitted range of up to 3 degrees Fahrenheit.

test_cases.title: Equivalence Partitioning - Error Deviation Class (5.0°F)
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is active and monitoring thermostat with target setpoint at 72.0°F.
test_cases.expected_result: A temperature deviation error is reported because 5.0°F exceeds the permitted threshold of 3 degrees Fahrenheit.
